title: Legend Wrap

complexity.rationale: s1's `_labelWrap` is an internal, underscore-prefixed prototype rather than a finalized public API, so porting it to S2 isn't a pure mechanical copy: a design review is needed to decide the final S2 API/UX for legend label wrapping before implementation, and that decision could also affect whether s1's internal prop gets promoted/renamed to match. One open design decision plus a non-trivial (but precedented) build is a 3, not a 2.

summary: s1's Legend already supports word-boundary wrapping and final-line ellipsis truncation via the `_labelWrap` prop, `wrapLabelText` expression function, and their wiring into the legend label encode — satisfying the wrap + truncation behavior this issue requested, but only as an internal, underscore-prefixed feature, not a finalized public API. S2 has no equivalent at all. This spec is pending a design review to decide the final S2 implementation (and possibly the final public-facing shape of the s1 API) before work proceeds.
requirements: Legend labels that exceed the configured width should wrap onto multiple lines instead of being truncated immediately.
Wrapping must break on word boundaries only, never mid-word.
If a label still doesn't fit after wrapping to the maximum number of lines, the final line should be truncated with an ellipsis rather than overflowing.
Different use cases should be able to choose different truncation/wrap behavior.

edgeCases.case: A single word longer than the wrap width
edgeCases.expectedBehavior: `wrapLabelText`'s `fitLine` falls back to `truncateText` for that line since there's no earlier word boundary to break on (packages/vega-spec-builder/src/expressionFunctions/expressionFunctions.ts:315-316).

edgeCases.case: `_labelWrap` used together with `legendLabels` custom label overrides
edgeCases.expectedBehavior: The wrap expression resolves the custom label via the same `_labels` lookup used elsewhere before wrapping (packages/vega-spec-builder/src/legend/legendUtils.ts:233-234).

Not guaranteed by the current implementation — the JSDoc explicitly scopes verified behavior to horizontal legends combined with `_preferredColumns` (packages/vega-spec-builder/src/types/legendSpec.types.ts:63-66).
Currently unsupported — the prop and its supporting expression functions don't exist anywhere in vega-spec-builder-s2 or react-spectrum-charts-s2.

crossCutting.notes: s1 (vega-spec-builder + react-spectrum-charts) has full wrap+truncation support via `_labelWrap`/`wrapLabelText`, but only as an internal, underscore-prefixed prop — not a reviewed public API. vega-spec-builder-s2 and react-spectrum-charts-s2 have no equivalent at all (no `_labelWrap`, `_preferredColumns`, or `wrapLabelText` anywhere in either package's src). A design review is needed to decide the final S2 API/UX before building it; that decision may also prompt finalizing/renaming s1's internal prop to match.

implementationPlan.change: Reference precedent only — already defines `_labelWrap?: number` (max lines before truncation) on `LegendOptions`; this is the pattern the S2 design should be evaluated against, not necessarily copied as-is.

Reference precedent only — already implements `wrapLabelText`, which splits text on whitespace (never mid-word) and wraps up to `_labelWrap` lines, truncating only the final line with an ellipsis when it still overflows.
Reference precedent only — already wires `_labelWrap` into the legend `labels` encode (`getLegendLabelsEncodings`), invoking `wrapLabelText` and vertically re-centering the symbol via `dy`.
Reference precedent only — already sets `legend.gridAlign = 'none'` when `_labelWrap > 1` so wrapped multi-line labels don't get auto-centered.

Not yet built. Once design review lands on a final API, add the equivalent wrap/truncation option here — pending the design decision on naming and whether it should be public from the start (unlike s1's underscore-prefixed prop).
Not yet built. Once design review lands, port the wrap-expression wiring into the S2 legend label encode, following the s1 precedent above as a starting point, not a required exact match.

openQuestions: What is the final public-facing API for legend label wrapping in S2 — a new prop name/shape, or should s1's internal `_labelWrap` be promoted to a public prop and mirrored as-is? Needs design review before implementation.
Should wrapping remain scoped to horizontal legends only (as s1's current implementation is), or does S2 design want it supported for vertical (left/right) legends too?
